name: Protopasta Static Dissipative PLA
filament_notes:
Static Dissipative PLA. TDS: 210-230C, 60C plate, up to 12 mm3/s, 0.4 mm or larger nozzle. Material Data Table: 220C up to 6 mm3/s, 240C up to 12 mm3/s, 55C plate.
Use Magigoo or glue stick so prints don't fuse to the plate; purge extra on filament changes.
